text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a specific operating system and often perform better, while cross-platform apps save time and money because one codebase works on several platforms. Responsive design is also essential, as users expect apps to look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps are usually published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where they must meet certain rules. Finally, performance matters a lot: a fast, smooth app keeps users happy and stops them from deleting it.
